A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Metalic paper, with 17 complete pages and Appendices A.1–A.6. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the paper content is identical apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original ProteinGym experiments, baseline comparisons, ablations, and attention analyses in Sections 4–5, with additional experimental results in Appendices A.2–A.5.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experiments and analyses in Sections 4–5 and Appendices A.2–A.5.

M1.justification: The architecture, ranking objective, meta-training, and fine-tuning procedures in Section 3 and the appendix are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ProteinGym single-mutant and multi-mutant fitness-prediction tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. No dataset or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: The baseline membership in every corresponding comparison is unchanged, including the zero-shot baselines, few-shot baselines, and Reptile variants in the main text and appendix.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and the appendix retain identical splits, preprocessing, support/query sizes, Spearman-correlation evaluation, training budgets, and experimental controls.

E4.justification: The component ablations, training-task sensitivity analyses, attention maps, augmentation ablation, and fine-tuning warm-up comparison are unchanged, including the appendix analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same three-seed means and standard deviations for the main experiments and the same single-seed tuning procedure in Appendix A.2. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains Metalic's Spearman correlations of .482 ± .002, .484 ± .001, and .552 ± .009 for 0, 16, and 128 shots.

T1.justification: The task definitions, Equations (1)–(5), and associated mathematical reasoning are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added, removed, or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about low-data performance, combining in-context meta-learning with fine-tuning, and strong few-shot results with 18 times fewer parameters.

C2.justification: Interpretations of unsupervised in-context adaptation, the limitations attributed to scarce multi-mutant training data, and the auxiliary predictor's differing usefulness across tasks remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, Table 7 hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures, and code-access information are unchanged, including Appendices A.1, A.2, and A.6.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list, and the positioning relative to ProteinNPT, other PLMs, and gradient-based meta-learning are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2, 31 Jan 2025, to v3, 15 Jul 2025. The prose, terminology, headings, and document structure are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, placements, and page layouts are unchanged. The marginal arXiv stamp changes text only, as recorded under P1.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp does not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
